challenge: Concurrent immutable artifact writers could observe a target path before the winning process had finished writing its bytes.
observedFailure: A losing create-if-absent writer received EEXIST and compared against the winner's partially written destination; valid identical concurrent writes could be rejected as immutable conflicts.
resolution: Write and fsync a private same-directory temporary inode then atomically publish it with link and remove the private inode in a bounded finally path.
knownLimitations: This guarantees complete local filesystem publication only; distributed object-store semantics and cross-host locking are not claimed.
